Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Record relevant official API/version decisions when changing infrastructure.

- [ ] Existing changes and licenses preserved; no application implementation imports across runtime boundaries.
- [ ] Targeted tests and required affected/full checks pass for this HEAD; include content ID/log links and OS/toolchain.
- [ ] Blueprint changes regenerated and rehearsed; actual native OS tests included when required.
- [ ] No assertion removal, skipped tests or unjustified baseline/threshold updates.
- [ ] External configuration and operations actually performed are explicit; no implied deployment/publication.

Merge only when explicitly authorized and current HEAD/base, required checks, reviews and conflicts satisfy repository rules.
